stories.headline: Rajasthan judge's disability rating dispute brings her back to Supreme Court
stories.title: Rajasthan judge's disability rating dispute brings her back to Supreme Court
stories.summary: Striving for equality in the justice system, Rekha Sharma aims to become a civil judge in Rajasthan. Armed with a disability certificate, she qualified for the necessary exams. In a twist, a Supreme Court ruling led to a reduction in her disability percentage. Ultimately, the Supreme Court overturned the Rajasthan High Court's objections and mandated her appointment, showcasing the barriers individuals with disabilities face during the selection process.
